description: Header file providing support for evaluating Python expressions and statements from strings and files using pybind11. Includes functions for eval and exec with different modes, handling of builtins, and conditional support for eval_file depending on interpreter.

methods.name: ensure_builtins_in_globals
methods.description: Ensures the '__builtins__' module is present in the globals dictionary, especially for PyPy and older Python versions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a Python expression string with specified mode, global, and local contexts.

methods.name: eval (overload with char array)
methods.description: Supports raw string literals by removing common leading whitespace before evaluation.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a sequence of Python statements from a string.

methods.name: eval_file
methods.description: Evaluates a Python script file, with support depending on interpreter capabilities.
